summary: NewHold Investment Corp III, a Cayman-domiciled Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 11, 2026 Forward Purchase Agreement with newcleo Ltd. and an unaffiliated stockholder in connection with their pending business combination announced May 26, 2026, structured as a two-step Cayman merger. Terms, share price, stake and premium were not disclosed in the excerpt. The prepaid forward addresses redemption overhang by locking up Class A shares ahead of closing. Watch redemption levels, forward unwind mechanics, PIPE adequacy and the regulatory clock toward the de-SPAC vote.
